newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES.

text.p: English and Scottish league
fixtures for November 30 to December 2:
Saturday, November 30:
English premier league - Aston Villa v Middlesbrough,
Blackburn v Southampton, Derby v Coventry, Everton v Sunderland,
Manchester United v Leicester, Newcastle v Arsenal, Sheffield
Wednesday v West Ham, Wimbledon v Nottingham Forest.
English division one - Bolton v Barnsley, Bradford v West
Bromwich, Grimsby v Crystal Palace, Norwich v Birmingham, Oxford
v Charlton, Port Vale v Huddersfield, Portsmouth v Stoke, Queens
Park Rangers v Sheffield United, Southend v Oldham, Swindon v
Reading, Tranmere v Ipswich.
English division two - Bournemouth v Luton, Bristol Rovers v
Bury, Crewe v Shrewsbury, Millwall v Brentford, Notts County v
Bristol City, Peterborough v Rotherham, Plymouth v Burnley,
Preston v Gillingham, Stockport v Walsall, Watford v Blackpool,
Wrexham v Wycombe, York v Chesterfield.
English division three - Carlisle v Barnet, Colchester v
Lincoln, Darlington v Northampton, Doncaster v Cambridge, Fulham
v Brighton, Hartlepool v Exeter, Hereford v Chester, Hull v
Wigan, Leyton Orient v Cardiff, Mansfield v Scarborough,
Rochdale v Scunthorpe, Swansea v Torquay.
Scottish premier division - Celtic v Hearts, Dundee United v
Dunfermline, Hibernian v Motherwell, Raith v Kilmarnock.
Scottish division one - Clydebank v Dundee, Falkirk v East
Fife, Partick v Greenock Morton, St Johnstone v Stirling, St
Mirren v Airdrieonians.
Scottish division two - Ayr v Dumbarton, Berwick v Brechin,
Clyde v Livingston, Hamilton v Stenhousemuir, Queen of South v
Stranraer.
Scottish division three - Alloa v Queen's Park, Arbroath v
Inverness Thistle, Cowdenbeath v Forfar, Montrose v Albion, Ross
County v East Stirling.
Sunday, December 1:
English premier league - Leeds v Chelsea
English division one - Wolverhampton v Manchester City
Scottish premier division - Aberdeen v Rangers
Monday, December 2:
English premier league - Tottenham v Liverpool
